recording_attribution.source_quote: Better. All of the recordings are off my test unit. None are anonymous or someone else
recording_attribution.scope: All existing Z100 Master recording batches: historical probes and scanner occurrences, separate owner scan, collision-test scan, and separate 3CH cohort. Not other models or future contributors.
recording_attribution.qualification: Same test unit does not establish the same configuration, firmware, mode, or cross-scan physical clip identity. No prototype or production status is inferred.

firmware_provenance.source: owner UI-log observation; not intrinsic per-clip metadata
firmware_provenance.qualification: Protocol field observations only; no physical mapping or count of units established. Separate owner Mini3X version is not attributed to this card.

methodology: All 72 actual videos in the saved inventory have canonical retained header measurements. They are new versus the earlier 60-clip path/size evidence; historical cohorts remain unchanged.

64 paired native measurements are alternate observations, not additional clips. Pre-fix native rear Q_ classification was Driving; component metadata was empty because of ANSI framing, not proof of absent component identity.

Owner confirms inside is telephoto and this card uses time-lapse. Front S_ and rear Q_ are positive time-lapse evidence scoped to this card. Other clips are driving-inferred. No telephoto time-lapse is observed; this does not establish universal disablement.
Full-length is video playback duration >=59.9 seconds; other clips are short/partial. Playback FPS does not establish capture cadence or elapsed coverage. Quality, HDR and power are not inferred.
No media was opened for integration; only saved JSON was read. Original paths, dates, IDs, hashes and raw logs are excluded.
